MATCH (p:Player)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team)
MATCH (p)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND p.current_team = t.team_name
RETURN DISTINCT t.founded_year AS col1, t.team_name AS col2, p.name AS col3, p.current_team AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
